name: Voter ID / Electoral Roll Enrolment (Form 6)
description: Registration of names in the electoral roll and issuance of Electors Photo Identity Card (EPIC / Voter ID) by the Election Commission of India.
eligibility: Indian citizen, 18+ years on qualifying date, ordinary resident of the constituency.
benefits: Right to vote in elections; EPIC serves as identity and address proof.
application_steps: Visit nvsp.in or voterportal.eci.gov.in and register/login.
Fill Form 6 (new enrolment) with details and upload documents.
BLO verifies at residence; name added to draft roll.
faqs: Is Aadhaar mandatory for voter enrolment?
How do I apply for a Voter ID?
How do I correct my name in the voter list?
